CLIENT_ACCOUNT.expr: pick({'Financial Services': ['Harborline Bank', 'Meridian Capital Group', 'Clearwater Wealth', 'Atlas Securities', 'Keystone Insurance'], 'Pharmaceutical': ['Corvane Therapeutics', 'Helix BioPharma', 'Polaris Life Sciences', 'Juniper Pharma'], 'Law Firm': ['Brennan Moreau LLP', 'Hughes & Okafor LLP', 'Lindqvist Petrov LLP', 'Reid Fischer Partners'], 'Technology': ['Brightline Software', 'Cobalt Cloud Systems', 'Lumen Robotics'], 'Construction': ['Granite Ridge Builders', 'Ironclad Infrastructure'], 'Retail': ['Evergreen Retail Group', 'Summit Outfitters']}[r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY']])

MATTER_TYPE.expr: weighted({'Commercial Litigation': 28, 'Regulatory Investigation': 18 + (10 if r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY'] == 'Financial Services' else 0), 'Internal Investigation': 14, 'Competition / Antitrust': 8 + (14 if r['REGION'] == 'DACH' else 0), 'IP Litigation': 6 + (18 if r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY'] == 'Pharmaceutical' else 0), 'Data Breach Response': 8 + (10 if r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY'] == 'Retail' else 0), 'DSAR': 6 + (8 if r['REGION'] in ('UK & Ireland', 'DACH') else 0), 'Construction Dispute': 1 + (40 if r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY'] == 'Construction' else 0)})

REVIEW_LANGUAGE.expr: weighted({'German': 70, 'English': 30}) if r['REGION'] == 'DACH' else weighted({'Portuguese': 80, 'English': 20}) if r['REGION'] == 'Brazil' else weighted({'Mandarin': 45, 'Cantonese': 15, 'English': 40}) if r['REGION'] == 'Greater China' else weighted({'Arabic': 45, 'English': 55}) if r['REGION'] == 'Middle East' else weighted({'English': 94, 'French': 4, 'Spanish': 2})

REVIEW_TEAM.expr: 'Lineal Managed Review - Frankfurt' if r['REGION'] == 'DACH' else weighted({'Lineal Managed Review - Belfast': 80, 'Client Review Team': 20}) if r['REGION'] == 'UK & Ireland' else weighted({'Lineal Managed Review - Manila': 60, 'Lineal Managed Review - Nashville': 20, 'Client Review Team': 20}) if r['REGION'] in ('Greater China', 'Singapore & APAC') else weighted({'Lineal Managed Review - Nashville': 70, 'Lineal Managed Review - Manila': 15, 'Client Review Team': 15})

columns.name: CUSTODIAN_NAME
columns.expr: pick(['A.', 'B.', 'C.', 'D.', 'E.', 'F.', 'G.', 'H.', 'J.', 'K.', 'L.', 'M.', 'N.', 'P.', 'R.', 'S.', 'T.']) + ' ' + pick(['Smith', 'Garcia', 'Chen', 'Khan', 'Muller', 'Rossi', 'Patel', 'Novak', 'Tanaka', 'Dubois', 'Kim', 'Silva', 'Nguyen', 'Schmidt', 'Hughes', 'Lopez', 'Wright', 'Sato', 'Moreau', 'Singh', 'Fischer', 'Murphy', 'Costa', 'Bauer', 'Jensen', 'Okafor', 'Haddad', 'Ferreira', 'Mehta', 'Yamada'])

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE
columns.expr: weighted({'Email (Microsoft 365)': 44 - 18 * ramp(270), 'Microsoft Teams': 8 + 9 * ramp(270) * (1.5 if r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY'] == 'Financial Services' else 1), 'Slack': 4 + 5 * ramp(270) * (1.5 if r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY'] == 'Financial Services' else 1), 'WhatsApp / Mobile': 5 + 7 * ramp(270) * (1.5 if r['CLIENT_INDUSTRY'] == 'Financial Services' else 1), 'Google Workspace': 8, 'File Shares & OneDrive': 18, 'ERP & Structured Data': 5, 'Scanned Paper': 3})

columns.name: SOURCE_GROUP
columns.expr: 'Chat & Mobile' if r['DATA_SOURCE'] in ('Microsoft Teams', 'Slack', 'WhatsApp / Mobile') else 'Email' if r['DATA_SOURCE'] in ('Email (Microsoft 365)', 'Google Workspace') else 'Files & Structured'

columns.name: AMPLIFY_MODULE
columns.expr: weighted({'ChatCraft': 32, 'BotDetector': 10, 'Near-Dup & Threading': 20, 'None': 38}) if r['SOURCE_GROUP'] == 'Chat & Mobile' else weighted({'BotDetector': 34, 'Near-Dup & Threading': 30, 'PrivFinder': 10, 'Snippets': 8, 'None': 18}) if r['SOURCE_GROUP'] == 'Email' else weighted({'Images': 34, 'Near-Dup & Threading': 26, 'Automated Processing': 20, 'None': 20})

columns.name: REVIEW_METHOD
columns.expr: weighted({'Relativity aiR Assisted': 8 + 22 * ramp(400), 'TAR / CAL': 34, 'Hybrid': 22, 'Linear Human': 36 - 22 * ramp(400)})

columns.name: DOCS_COLLECTED
columns.expr: max(200, int(lognorm({'Email': 5200, 'Chat & Mobile': 3800, 'Files & Structured': 2600}[r['SOURCE_GROUP']], 0.85)))

columns.name: DATA_GB
columns.expr: r['DOCS_COLLECTED'] * uniform(0.12, 0.3) * (2.2 if r['DATA_SOURCE'] in ('WhatsApp / Mobile', 'Scanned Paper') else 1) / 1000

columns.name: DOCS_PROMOTED
columns.expr: int(r['DOCS_COLLECTED'] * uniform(0.8, 1.2) * ((0.115 + 0.11 * ramp(270)) if (r['SOURCE_GROUP'] == 'Chat & Mobile' and r['AMPLIFY_MODULE'] != 'ChatCraft') else 0.085 if r['SOURCE_GROUP'] == 'Chat & Mobile' else (0.072 if r['AMPLIFY_MODULE'] in ('BotDetector', 'Near-Dup & Threading', 'Images') else 0.095)))

columns.name: DOCS_REVIEWED
columns.expr: int(r['DOCS_PROMOTED'] * {'Relativity aiR Assisted': 0.32, 'TAR / CAL': 0.55, 'Hybrid': 0.75, 'Linear Human': 1.0}[r['REVIEW_METHOD']])

columns.name: DOCS_RESPONSIVE
columns.expr: int(r['DOCS_PROMOTED'] * uniform(0.18, 0.32))

columns.name: PRIV_DOCS
columns.expr: int(r['DOCS_RESPONSIVE'] * uniform(0.6, 1.4) * (0.04 + 0.05 * ramp(240) if r['REGION'] == 'DACH' else 0.042))

columns.name: DOCS_PRODUCED
columns.expr: max(0, r['DOCS_RESPONSIVE'] - r['PRIV_DOCS'])

columns.name: REVIEW_HOURS
columns.expr: r['DOCS_REVIEWED'] / (lognorm(58, 0.15) * (0.72 if r['SOURCE_GROUP'] == 'Chat & Mobile' else 1) * (0.8 if r['REVIEW_LANGUAGE'] != 'English' else 1)) + r['PRIV_DOCS'] / 18.0

columns.name: PRIV_TURNAROUND_HOURS
columns.expr: None if r['PRIV_DOCS'] == 0 else lognorm(30, 0.3) * (1 + 1.15 * ramp(240) if r['REGION'] == 'DACH' else 1)

columns.name: PRIV_BATCH_FLAG
columns.expr: 0 if r['PRIV_DOCS'] == 0 else 1

columns.name: SLA_MET_FLAG
columns.expr: 0 if r['PRIV_DOCS'] == 0 else (1 if r['PRIV_TURNAROUND_HOURS'] <= 72 else 0)

columns.name: QC_SAMPLED_DOCS
columns.expr: int(r['DOCS_REVIEWED'] * 0.1)

columns.name: QC_OVERTURNS
columns.expr: int(r['QC_SAMPLED_DOCS'] * (0.03 + 0.025 * ramp(240) if r['REGION'] == 'DACH' else 0.028) * uniform(0.6, 1.4) + uniform(0, 1))

columns.name: PROCESSING_COST
columns.expr: r['DATA_GB'] * uniform(35, 55)

columns.name: REVIEW_COST
columns.expr: r['REVIEW_HOURS'] * (lognorm(95, 0.1) if r['REVIEW_LANGUAGE'] != 'English' else lognorm(58, 0.1))

columns.name: TECHNOLOGY_COST
columns.expr: r['DOCS_PROMOTED'] * (0.12 if r['REVIEW_METHOD'] == 'Relativity aiR Assisted' else 0.03) + (r['DOCS_COLLECTED'] * 0.004 if r['AMPLIFY_MODULE'] != 'None' else 0)

columns.name: TOTAL_COST
columns.expr: r['PROCESSING_COST'] + r['REVIEW_COST'] + r['TECHNOLOGY_COST']

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.expr: (r['PROCESSING_COST'] + r['DOCS_COLLECTED'] * 0.085 * 0.7 * 62 / 58 + r['TECHNOLOGY_COST']) * uniform(1.0, 1.12)

columns.name: CHAT_DOCS_COLLECTED
columns.expr: r['DOCS_COLLECTED'] if r['SOURCE_GROUP'] == 'Chat & Mobile' else 0

status_rules.if: age <= 20 and r['PRIV_DOCS'] > 0 and r['REGION'] == 'DACH' and chance(0.15 + 0.55 * ramp(240))

post.name: DAYS_IN_STAGE
post.expr: age if r['WORKFLOW_STAGE'] in ('Processing', 'First-Pass Review', 'Privilege Review', 'QC', 'On Hold') else None
